Insightful Radiance +76: Passive: +76 Insight bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Insightful Devotion +76: Passive: +76 Insight bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.

Fearsome: This item causes those who strike the user to be overcome with terror, as from the Fear spell.
